objective: test whether the frozen predictability-aligned information allocation lowers real out-of-fold wind-residual denoising difficulty for a fixed-capacity tiny joint denoiser

already_observed: G0-A established that NWP predicts six-group conditional residual uncertainty
G0-B0 established numerical feasibility of eta=0.5 reserve-then-water-fill
G0-B0 exposed the analytic Gaussian proxy-risk advantage and eta sensitivity
prior_information_disclosure.consequence: this protocol is prospective for denoiser utility but not an independent preregistration of the already-inspected allocation formula

not_authorized: validation, calibration, selection, R-SEEN, or final target access
full D0-v training or scenario generation
changing paths, data fractions, metrics, margins, or seeds after P0 starts
choosing eta from any reconstruction outcome
claiming conditional multidimensional schedules, whitening, or reverse water-filling are new

scientific_estimand.primary_question: conditional on the same outer-train-fitted nuisance mean and variance information, does correct NWP-predictability-aligned allocation reduce finite-capacity held-out denoising risk under the same update budget?
scientific_estimand.sample_efficiency_scope: tiny-denoiser sample efficiency conditional on nuisance estimators fitted on the complete outer-training fold; not end-to-end sample efficiency of nuisance estimation plus diffusion
scientific_estimand.path_difference: only the corruption coordinate system or allocation of the matched Gaussian information budget
not_claimed: a tiny reconstruction Probe is a full generative model
held-out train folds are external validation
analytic Gaussian reference risk is observed model utility
G0-B can select Flow versus Diffusion
MuLAN-lite or CW-group exactly reproduces the full cited method

continuous_residual.conditional_mean: the exact G0-A outer-fold cellwise NWP ridge contract
continuous_residual.noisy_inactive_input: may be nonzero after orthogonal group corruption; the explicit active mask is always an input and inactive targets never enter loss or metrics

mode_registry.temporal_basis: orthonormal DCT-II over 24 physical hours with bands [0,4), [4,12), [12,24)
mode_registry.spatial_basis: orthogonal common projector 11^T/10 and local complement I-11^T/10
mode_registry.daily_weights: G0-A effective_rank divided by its six-group daily sum

outer_cross_fitting.assignment: reuse the exact six chronological G0-A outer folds
outer_cross_fitting.outer_training_residuals: reuse the G0-A four-fold nested out-of-fold conditional-mean construction inside the outer-training fold
outer_cross_fitting.outer_test_residuals: conditional mean fitted on the complete outer-training fold and applied to the outer-test fold
outer_cross_fitting.variance_fit: reuse G0-A inner selection and fit N1 on nested outer-training residual energies only
outer_cross_fitting.outer_training_variance_for_schedule: the outer-fold N1 fitted on all outer-training residual energies predicts those outer-training conditions; no outer-test target is used
outer_cross_fitting.outer_test_variance_for_schedule: the same fitted N1 predicts outer-test conditions
outer_cross_fitting.required_replay: outer-test residual energy, effective rank, selected nuisance hyperparameters, and N1 variance must match the frozen G0-A result within 1e-10 before P0

learning_curve.subset_rule: sort outer-training dates by SHA256('architecture_v1_g0_b_tiny_v1|'+str(34100+outer_fold)+'|'+ISO_date), take ceil(fraction*N) prefix, then restore chronological order
learning_curve.date_sha256_convention: SHA256 of chronologically sorted ISO dates joined by LF with no trailing LF
learning_curve.interpretation: same-compute denoiser learning curve with 25%, 50%, and 100% of outer-training residual days

baseline_information_contract.all_paths_budget: sum_k w_dk*I_path_dtk=B_dt for every day and timestep

shared_proxy_allocation.purpose: Fixed-band, MuLAN-lite, Predictability-aligned, and Shuffle share one safety and budget scaffold; only v_proxy changes

paths.definition: I_path=I_IID and alpha_bar_path=alpha_bar_0 for all six groups
u=sum_k Q_k(r)/sqrt(v_true_k); assign every whitened group I_k=B_dt, use scalar whitened SNR expm1(2*B_dt), predict whitened clean u, then unwhiten before the common raw-residual loss

paths.v_proxy: outer-fold effective-rank-weighted arithmetic mean of N1 variance over outer-training days, fixed across days and data fractions

paths.role: generic learned input-conditional six-group schedule control
paths.condition: the same standardized 47 correct condition features seen by every denoiser
paths.initialization: last layer exactly zero, so v_proxy starts at FIXED_BAND
paths.timestep_dependence: induced by the shared proxy allocation; the scheduler itself is condition-only, hence lite rather than a full MuLAN reproduction
paths.training: scheduler and common tiny denoiser are optimized jointly by the same raw-residual reconstruction objective

paths.v_proxy: correct outer-fold N1 variance for the same day

paths.denoiser_condition: always the correct same-day condition, mask, and N1 variance
paths.budget_and_reserve: always computed from correct same-day v_true and w_true
paths.v_proxy: wrong-day N1 variance selected by a registered within-partition derangement; effective-rank weights are never shuffled
paths.training_scope: within the current denoiser training subset
paths.evaluation_aggregation: average all four registered wrong-day schedules before a day-level contrast

common_corruption.epsilon: one IID N(0,I_240) physical-space draw shared across paths before orthogonal projection
common_corruption.CW_input: the corresponding scalar-VP corruption is applied after six-group whitening
common_corruption.network_target: clean residual in the path's internal coordinates
common_corruption.network_decoder: identity for raw paths; fixed same-day group unwhitening for CW_GROUP
common_corruption.optimization_loss: mean squared reconstructed raw residual error over active cells only
common_corruption.schedule_descriptor_input: six allocated log-SNR values clipped to [-20,12] for network input only; clipping never changes the corruption schedule

tiny_denoiser.purpose: capacity-limited joint 10x24 regression Probe, not a scenario model
tiny_denoiser.condition_features: 7 G0-A mask nuisance features + 34 G0-A NWP summaries + log of 6 correct N1 variances
tiny_denoiser.condition_standardization: fit on the complete outer-training fold only and freeze across fractions and paths
tiny_denoiser.input: 240 noisy values + 240 active-mask bits + 47 condition features + 6 allocated log-SNR values + 16 Fourier timestep values
tiny_denoiser.time_fourier_features: for frequencies 2^0 through 2^7, concatenate sin(2*pi*frequency*t/249) and cos(2*pi*frequency*t/249) in increasing-frequency order
tiny_denoiser.initialization: LayerNorm weight one/bias zero; hidden Linear weights Xavier-uniform/bias zero; output Linear weight and bias exact zero using the registered model-seed torch.Generator

training.learned_schedule_audit: MULAN_LITE must pass the full fold schedule budget, endpoint, positivity, finite-value, and monotonicity checks at every 128-update checkpoint and at final EMA
training.common_randomness: within each fold/fraction/model-seed, all paths share initial tiny-denoiser tensors, minibatch day indices, timesteps, Gaussian noise, and update count

evaluation_bank.allowed_targets: the current outer-test subset of the train role only

metrics.cell_MSE: active-cell squared raw-residual reconstruction error, averaged over registered timesteps and noise replicates
metrics.increment_MSE: squared error of adjacent-hour residual increments where both cells are active
metrics.joint_day_normalized_SSE: per-day active SSE divided by active_count times the outer-training active-residual second moment, then averaged over corruption bank
metrics.six_group_MSE: projected reconstruction-error energy divided by the same daily effective rank used by G0-A
metrics.gaussian_reference_risk: sum_k w_dk*v_true_dk*exp(-2*I_path_dtk), averaged over the same registered bank
metrics.oracle_efficiency_ratio: dimension-weighted six-group model reconstruction MSE divided by Gaussian reference risk; descriptive even when below one because the Gaussian reference is not asserted to be the true law
metrics.balanced_reconstruction_risk: equal mean of cell_MSE, increment_MSE, and joint_day_normalized_SSE after each endpoint is divided by its frozen all-day IID mean at the same data fraction
metrics.learning_curve_AULC: trapezoidal mean balanced reconstruction risk over log data fractions 0.25, 0.5, and 1.0
metrics.gradient_conflict: secondary-only cosine similarity of per-group gradients on a fixed train-only diagnostic bank

inference.within_day_aggregation: average evaluation noise replicates and registered timesteps; PA_SHUFFLE additionally averages its four evaluation derangements
inference.model_seed_aggregation: average the three model seeds within each outer-held-out calendar day before formal contrasts
inference.fold_aggregation: concatenate 267 out-of-fold day records; never treat fold, timestep, noise, cell, or mode as an independent replicate
inference.simultaneous_method: paired calendar-month max-T bootstrap over every registered confirmatory contrast

technical_eligibility: all lineage, target-role, fold, subset, nuisance-replay, finite-value, budget, monotonicity, positivity, paired-randomness, resume, and run-count checks pass
all 324 final EMA runs complete without validation-based selection
MULAN_LITE schedule-parameter overhead is at most 2 percent
PA_RWF is numerically identical to frozen G0-B0 on the frozen G0-A daily rows
go_no_go.optional_data_equivalence_milestone: PA_RWF at 50 percent data is noninferior to IID at 100 percent data within 1 percent; report but do not require for GO
go_no_go.GO_authorizes: design a separate full-model predictability-aligned diffusion protocol only; it does not authorize selection access or declare Diffusion the final family

decision_order: if PA_RWF fails its IID gate: classify G0_B_GENERIC_ADAPTIVITY_SUFFICIENT when MULAN_LITE materially beats IID, else G0_B_WHITENING_SUFFICIENT when CW_GROUP materially beats IID, else G0_B_FIXED_BAND_SUFFICIENT when FIXED_BAND materially beats IID, else G0_B_STRUCTURED_SCHEDULE_NO_GO
PA_RWF does not beat PA_SHUFFLE -> G0_B_NWP_ALIGNMENT_NO_GO
PA_RWF does not beat FIXED_BAND -> G0_B_FIXED_BAND_SUFFICIENT
PA_RWF does not beat CW_GROUP -> G0_B_WHITENING_SUFFICIENT
PA_RWF fails MuLAN-lite noninferiority or AULC superiority -> G0_B_GENERIC_ADAPTIVITY_SUFFICIENT when MULAN_LITE materially beats IID, otherwise G0_B_UNRESOLVED
raw PA_RWF gains pass but oracle-efficiency gain fails -> G0_B_ORACLE_ONLY_NO_LEARNING_GAIN

hard_checks: all artifact and code hashes match
all six outer folds and all nested subset hashes match
G0-A nuisance replay matches outer-test energy, effective rank, hyperparameters, and N1 variance
six projectors are symmetric orthogonal and sum to identity
all six paths match every daily information budget
all fixed and learned schedules are finite, strictly positive, and monotone after every P0 update
CW whitening and inverse-whitening reconstruct the active residual within 1e-10
base tiny-denoiser initialization and every common random tensor are paired across paths
MULAN_LITE starts exactly at FIXED_BAND and only its registered 870 scheduler parameters are additional
PA_SHUFFLE has no fixed points and changes only the schedule proxy variance
loss, gradients, optimizer state, EMA, and one train-subset diagnostic batch are finite
checkpoint resume exactly reproduces the next update
P0 output contains no .pt or .pth weight
